title: Fix Missing Hook Case for agent.tool.searching.ended
description: The PostToolUse hook is failing with "unknown hook event: agent.tool.searching.ended". The dispatchHook function in main.go has a case for HookAgentToolSearching but is missing a case for HookAgentToolSearched (agent.tool.searching.ended). Need to add the missing case.
summary: Added search event enrichment to execute safe search commands, map matched/read lines to definition IDs, and emit definitions[{id,loc}] for agent.tool.search.starting/ended; added focused tests.
